inicio.kicker: Cinema with AI Program · course 2 of 6 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Production: from script to finished film, with sound, editing, color and label
inicio.lead: Generated shots are not a film yet. Here you decide the beats and the deliverables, the sound for each shot, the edit, the color, a path without a video generator, the ad and what the law requires. Each lesson ends with a file that the page itself checks, including the final video, with no terminal and no credits spent.
inicio.capa_alt: A dark editing room with a cutting monitor showing the timeline, studio headphones and a clapperboard on the desk.
inicio.aulas_sub: The scene from course 0, "The first batch", becomes a 30 to 60 s short. Four rehearsal clips come ready, so you can put it together without generating anything.

itens: Creators, teachers and people who make videos for companies.
People who already have a shot list (course 0) or already generate clips (course 1) and want to finish the film.
People who don't use a terminal: everything is done in the browser, in a free editor and in a text file.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Plan beats, sources and deliverables before spending credits.
Decide the sound for each shot: what comes with the video and what is added later.
Edit, caption and color the film in a free editor.
Publish with a label and with image, voice and music rights sorted out.
